facts.business: Reliance Infrastructure Limited is a diversified infrastructure company with capabilities across E&C, power utilities, transportation and emerging segments such as defence and renewable energy.

segments.name: Clean Energy Solutions (Solar and Battery Storage)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Growth is expected to recover to 6–8% in Financial Year 2026–27, supported by a revival in road project awards and continued momentum in water and infrastructure projects.

auditor.name: M/s. Paresh Rakesh & Associates LLP, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of Opinion due to inability to determine recovery of Economic Rights of shareholding in Odisha Discoms aggregating to ₹4,705.74 crore; ongoing proceedings by ED, SEBI SCN, SFIO and ADT-4 filing; Emphasis of Matter on going concern uncertainty, change in accounting policy for investments, rectification of accounting treatment adjusting loss of ₹5,024.88 crore against retained earnings, Scheme of Arrangement with Reliance Velocity Limited, exceptional items of ₹(730.35) crore, and MMOPL loan default and debt assignment to NARCL.

key_risks: Uncertainty in recovery of Economic Rights in Odisha Discoms (₹4,705.74 crore)
Ongoing regulatory and legal proceedings by ED, SEBI, SFIO
Going concern uncertainty due to current liabilities exceeding current assets and guarantee obligations
MMOPL loan default, debt assignment to NARCL, and pending insolvency proceedings
TKTR and HKTR financial stress with current liabilities exceeding assets and termination notices
Arbitration and litigation outcomes with MMRDA and NHAI
Dependence on uncertain timelines for asset monetization and dispute resolution
facts.related_party_note: Scheme of Arrangement between Reliance Infrastructure Limited and its wholly owned subsidiary Reliance Velocity Limited sanctioned by NCLT, effective September 30, 2025.
